note: D98: three phases (front end → Zoho → test). The forecast is loop time: units left × minutes per unit ÷ loop hours per day. minutes_per_unit are assumptions until a phase has 5 measured rounds; then the measured average replaces them. loop_hours_per_day is how long the laptop runs /build each day. test_days is the people's testing after the loop (tester, UAT). build_target is the owner's goal date; the forecast is compared with it. Minutes per unit set on 27 Sep from the D98 test run: even stories marked 'built' pass only about a quarter of their cases, so they are not treated as free.
